name: BoxSpecV2 in plain words
about: Plain words for the CQ11 v2 menu (F119-F123). The site shows one button per side: keep, burn, grow the pool; eat the price coin; pay holders in {P}; or pay every item of your own collection in {P}. Legacy wire labels are for refusals, never extra choices.
A failed box pays its closing price through a claim. Both fee sides use the price coin. Royalties in another coin go through the conversion Safe and return in the price coin.
Placeholders: {P} the price coin symbol; {T} the box coin ticker. Never show those letters on their own.

boxType.label: Contents
boxType.what: What the box holds besides its token.
boxType.tell: Just the token, a new collection, a shop, or a seeded coin pile.

tokenName.label: Token name
tokenName.tell: Up to 32 characters, printable ASCII, no quotes or backslashes.

collectionName.label: Collection name
collectionName.tell: Up to 32 characters; empty for just the token or a shop or pile.

collectionSymbol.label: Collection symbol
collectionSymbol.tell: Up to 11 characters; empty for just the token or a shop or pile.

n.label: Items
n.what: How many items the collection has.
n.tell: 10 to 10,000; 0 for just the token or a shop or pile.

firstId.label: First item
firstId.tell: 1; 0 for just the token or a shop or pile.

pricing.label: Price coin
pricing.what: The coin the box is priced in, by its listing.
pricing.tell: Pick a listed coin. Graduated box coins also need a listing.

raise.label: Raise
raise.tell: The lister sets the raise. Updates apply only to new boxes; this box keeps the raise recorded at creation.

openAt.label: Opens
openAt.tell: Now, or a time within 14 days.

deadlineDays.label: Deadline
deadlineDays.what: Days to graduate before the box closes.

buyers.label: Buyers' fees
buyers.what: Where buyers' fees go, paid in {P}.
buyers.tell: Keep, burn, grow the pool, eat the price coin, pay holders in {P}, or pay every own-collection item in {P}.

sellers.label: Sellers' fees
sellers.what: Where sellers' fees go, paid in {P}.
sellers.tell: Keep, burn, grow the pool, eat the price coin, pay holders in {P}, or pay every own-collection item in {P}.

artMode.label: Art
artMode.tell: Open: shown at creation. Hidden: revealed by draws.

metadataTable.label: Traits
metadataTable.tell: Up to 24,575 bytes; loaded after creation.

generatorHash.label: Generator
generatorHash.what: The art generator's fingerprint, if any.

revealListId.label: Reveal list
revealListId.what: The public list of the art.

creatorFeeRecipient.label: Payout address
creatorFeeRecipient.tell: Needed when you pick keep or send royalties to yourself.

creatorBuy.label: Your buy at start
creatorBuy.what: What you buy before anyone else, in {P}.

contentsParams.label: Contents settings
contentsParams.what: Settings for a shop or a pile.
contentsParams.tell: For shops: seed in {T}, four fixed give prices, a pick price of 1.25x, 1.5x, 2x or 3x, weekly allowances, list delay, curator and collections. For piles: one listed seed coin, an exact seed amount including zero, and 0 or 500 basis points left for remaining holders on redemption. The last holder takes all. Empty for other box types.

pickFeeBps.label: Pick fee
pickFeeBps.what: The fee for picking a named item.
pickFeeBps.tell: 1%, 5% or 25%; 0 for just the token or a shop or pile.

NEW_COLLECTION.label: A new collection
NEW_COLLECTION.plain: A new NFT collection in the box's vault.

SHOP.label: A shop
SHOP.plain: Give or pick NFTs at fixed prices in {T}. Seed and pick receipts fund the shop. Sellers can choose Into the shop: fees fill the shop up to a ceiling, then go to holders.

PILE.label: A coin pile
PILE.plain: One listed coin, funded by your seed after creation. After graduation, hand in {T} for a share. A To the pile choice adds the price coin after graduation when it is the same coin.

CURVE_V1.label: Curve v1
CURVE_V1.plain: About 80% of the token on a curve.

FULL_RANGE.label: Full range
FULL_RANGE.plain: One pool position across the full price range.

CURVE.label: Curve
CURVE.plain: The token sells on a curve.

AsPaid.label: In {P}
AsPaid.plain: Keeps the fee in the price coin for its chosen destination.

BuyT.label: Buy back to burn
BuyT.plain: The burn button buys {T} after graduation, on either fee side.

RESERVED_3.label: Sell the box coin
RESERVED_3.plain: Not offered. Both fee sides already arrive in {P}.

RESERVED_4.label: Convert
RESERVED_4.plain: No conversion choice in this release.

RESERVED_5.label: Plug-in
RESERVED_5.plain: Plug-ins wait for a later version.

Eat.label: Burn
Eat.plain: BuyT burns the purchased {T}; AsPaid burns checked {P}, otherwise locks it at the dead address. Both wait for graduation.

Creator.label: Keep
Creator.plain: Claim your share in {P} after graduation.

RESERVED_3.label: To FIT
RESERVED_3.plain: FIT receives its fixed share; this is not an extra button.

Depth.label: Grow the pool
Depth.plain: Adds to this box's pool after graduation, for good.

RESERVED_5.label: To another box
RESERVED_5.plain: Gifts to another box wait for a later version.

Holders.label: To holders
Holders.plain: Your eligible holdings of {T} at each trade earn {P}. Claim funded credits with no expiry, including after failure.

BudgetOrPile.label: Into the shop or to the pile
BudgetOrPile.plain: The chosen fee share waits as {P}; anyone moves it into the same-coin pile after graduation. Failed pending fees join the closing pot, separately from the seed.

Items.label: To items
Items.plain: Each item has equal weight. Outside items earn {P}; inside shares are kept with the item, buy back and burn {T}, or grow this box’s own pool, as chosen for that side. Before graduation, shares wait; if the box fails they join the closing claim.
Items.insidePolicy: Choose Keep, buy back and burn, or grow the pool; Keep is the default.

NoSplit.label: One whole choice
NoSplit.plain: The whole share follows one button.

RESERVED_2.label: Split
RESERVED_2.plain: Splits are not offered. Pick one whole choice.

RESERVED_3.label: Creator cap
RESERVED_3.plain: Creator caps wait for a later version.

RESERVED_4.label: Rule plug-in
RESERVED_4.plain: Plug-ins wait for a later version.

Keep.label: Keep
Keep.plain: Keep each inside share with its item; its current owner can claim after picking it.

BuyBackBurn.label: Buy back and burn
BuyBackBurn.plain: Use inside shares to buy and burn {T} in this box’s pool. Shares held before graduation all follow this burn choice.

Depth.label: Grow the pool
Depth.plain: Inside shares stay in {P} and go to this box’s own liquidity pool, for good. Shares held before graduation all go to the pool. With the box token, only outside shares buy {T}.

STOCK.label: Stock
STOCK.plain: A tokenized stock; its issuer can pause it.

BOX_TOKEN.label: A box's token
BOX_TOKEN.plain: A graduated box coin admitted by the lister.

FEE_HANDLING.label: Like fees
FEE_HANDLING.plain: Split in {P} like buyers' fees, using the buyers' button. A holders button sends these royalties to the pool.

CREATOR.label: To you
CREATOR.plain: Paid whole to your payout address in {P}, after graduation.

POOL_DEPTH.label: Into the pool
POOL_DEPTH.plain: Adds to this box's pool in {P}, after graduation.

placeholders.label: Hidden art (placeholders)
placeholders.what: Tickets during the curve; items revealed by draws.

edition-specials.label: Edition specials
edition-specials.what: Named series of special items, shown as counts.

royalties.label: Royalties
royalties.what: A suggested rate on item resales. Marketplaces may choose whether to pay it.

destination.label: Where
destination.what: Like fees, to you, or into the pool.

royalties.beforeGraduation: Royalties in {P} wait until graduation, then follow your chosen destination.
royalties.otherCoin: Royalties in another coin go to the conversion Safe. The bot converts them to the price coin and pays them back to this box as royalties, following your chosen destination.
royalties.conversionSafe: The conversion Safe has a fixed address. Two of its three owners must sign: bot, founder and backup. A failed transfer can be retried without stopping the box.
royalties.failure: Held royalties in {P} join the closing claim. Money arriving after the last claim goes to the FIT Safe.

collection-metadata.label: Collection page
collection-metadata.what: A banner, teasers and a link.

collection-list.label: Collection list
collection-list.what: The shop accepts listed collections at fixed tiers. A curator may only add, at most weekly; renouncing freezes the list. Entries wait 7, 14 or 30 days.

starter-set.label: Starter set
starter-set.what: Load the committed NFTs from your approvals after creation. The full set and the seed must arrive before completion opens trading. A seed-only shop uses an empty set.

setHash.label: Set fingerprint
setHash.what: Commits the ordered items and tiers; empty for a seed-only set.

count.label: Items
count.what: 10 to 10,000, or 0 for a seed-only set.

held-item-earnings.label: Earnings of held items
held-item-earnings.what: Earnings in the price coin arrive with M2. Earnings in another coin wait for a later version.
held-item-earnings.notOffered: M2; another coin in a later version

humble-creator.label: Creator cap
humble-creator.what: Creator caps are not offered in this release.

open art publishes its reveal list.fix: Set the reveal list, or pick hidden art.

no fee recipient without a creator payou.fix: Clear it, or send something to you.

keep.label: Keep
keep.plain: Your share waits until graduation, then you can claim it in {P}.

eat.label: Eat the price coin
eat.plain: After graduation, Burn {P} when its listing records a checked burn; Lock {P} otherwise, including ETH. The Eaten counter adds only successful amounts. Pending money joins the failure claim pot.

burn.label: Burn
burn.plain: Your share buys {T} in small steps after graduation and burns it. The buy pays the usual fee.

grow.label: Grow the pool
grow.plain: Your share grows this box's pool after graduation, for good.

holders.label: To holders
holders.plain: Your eligible holdings of {T} at each trade earn {P}. Claim funded credits with no expiry, including after failure.

items.label: To items
items.plain: Each item has equal weight. Outside items earn {P}; inside shares are kept with the item, buy back and burn {T}, or grow this box’s own pool, as chosen for that side. Before graduation, shares wait; if the box fails they join the closing claim.
items.insidePolicy: Choose Keep, buy back and burn, or grow the pool; Keep is the default.

menu.fees: 1% of every buy and every sale, in {P}.
menu.shares: Of each fee split: 2/15 to FIT, 1/15 to the platform, 2/15 to the pool and 10/15 to your choice.

shop.label: Into the shop
shop.plain: Sellers only, for every shop: fees fill the shop up to a ceiling, then go to holders. Fix the ceiling at creation to 2x, 4x or 8x the seed, counting fees. Only what the shop wants buys its token after graduation; the rest pays holders in the price coin, also before graduation. whoever picks the collections decides who can sell into a budget the fees pay for
shop.timing: Collection time decides the destination, not trade time. Weeks are anchored to graduation. The first give, pick or fee intake in a week snapshots the budget before it; after idle weeks the live budget is used. Purchases also check the live ceiling. Pending shares and small tails that cannot buy go to the original trade holders; failure sends still-pending fees to the closing pot.

menu.oneChoice: Pick one button for buyers and one for sellers. Each choice takes the whole share.

lifecycle.graduation: The curve graduates into one full-range pool position.
lifecycle.graduationEscape: If the curve filled but graduation has not succeeded for 7 days, anyone can close the box into the same closing claim.
lifecycle.claim: Claim {P} at the closing price by handing in {T}. Each claim takes its share of the remaining pot; the last takes the remainder. Claims have no expiry.
lifecycle.graduationReserve: If the box fails, the graduation reserve is split like fees.
lifecycle.heldBurnMoney: If the box fails, waiting buy-back money joins the claim.
lifecycle.heldItemsMoney: If the box fails, waiting item earnings join the claim.
lifecycle.afterLastClaim: Money arriving after the last claim goes to the FIT Safe.

pile.seed: Choose one listed coin other than this box’s own {T}, and an exact seed amount. You are the seeder. Load it after creation; a nonzero seed must arrive before trading opens. It is separate from the creation payment.
pile.redemption: After graduation, hand in {T} to receive its share of the pile’s live balance. Fixed-coin gifts join that balance.
pile.failure: After failure, only the recorded seed returns to you, with retry if the coin refuses payment. Unsolicited surplus and unrelated assets have no recovery path.

operations.fitSafe: FIT shares go to a fixed Safe. Two of three owners must sign: bot, founder and backup. The bot cannot move money alone.
operations.platformCap: The platform keeps at most 32 ETH per 30 days under its off-chain policy. This is not a creator cap.
operations.pricing: Use the listed price coin. Route other coins through Uniswap before creating or buying into a box.
